title: GATE-403-474: gate loop gets HTTP 403 on executor-opened PR #474
body:
**Owner:** lane
**Trigger:** loop_beats gate ok=0 with status 403 (D1 ultrastable-org)
**Done check:** grep:docs/issues/GATE-403-474.json::Status:\*\* closed
**Status:** closed

After SUBREQUEST-ROTATION-2 the tick Worker no longer hits Too many subrequests; the gate loop now ends `errors: ultrastable/ultrastable#474 status 403`. #474 was opened by the executor (ROADMAP-AGENT-CONNECTOR-HEALTH) and adds src/qnfo/connector_health.py, a QNFO-named path that does not belong in this repository.

Fix: the gate records a 403 on one PR as that PR's disposition instead of failing the loop; #474 closes as superseded or moves to a tenant path; the executor refuses QNFO-named paths here.

size: S

**Closing probe:** loop_beats gate ok=1 in two consecutive slots and #474 closed with a recorded disposition.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 99.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
